text:
Jordan Lee: quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A thread. i'm dropping a compact list of clarifications, links, and owners that came up. please react or reply if anything's off or if you want to take an action.

Ava Chen: thanks jordan! one clarification on GA timing: Dedicated is 'late Q2' for now. i promised a concrete date by next wednesday; will post it in this thread when locked. :calendar:

Miguel Torres: pricing note 1: provisional reserved-tier numbers live in the spreadsheet linked in the deck. i'll copy a summary into the pricing doc next week.

Priya Patel: private/VPC onboarding: we can start pilot installs in customer VPCs mid-june (pre full control-plane GA). each wave needs ~2 engs for onboarding. will draft checklist.

Samir (ops-bot): docs: runbook created by @Priya - https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-onboard

Jordan Lee: captured action items below (short):
- Miguel: add provisional Dedicated pricing + short FAQ blurb in pricing doc (owner: @Miguel).
- Priya & SRE: produce first three onboarding checklists, include per-customer eng-hours estimate (owner: @Priya).
- Ava & Product Comms: confirm GA date by next Wed and update comms plan (owner: @Ava).
- Jordan (DevEx): schedule 30-min office hours post-GA and draft partner-facing FAQ (owner: @Jordan).

Rashid Khan: can someone draft a 1-paragraph sales blurb on failure modes and fallbacks (routing, model-variant fallback, expected latency delta)? need by EOD.

Miguel Torres: i got this, will post a 3-sentence blurb in #sales by EOD.

Leah Martinez: legal note: onboarding checklist must include explicit data-residency checkbox plus KMS/HSM config and audit-log export confirmations.

Priya Patel: acked. adding KMS/HSM + audit-log export items to checklist.

Elliot Park: can someone paste the roadmap slide link (i lost it after the call)?

Jordan Lee: deck link: https://redwood.internal/slides/allhands-may2026

Ava Chen: leadership follow-up ask: propose a tiny beta of 3 anchor customers for Private so we can surface infra patterns early. @Priya @Miguel please sync to nominate candidates.

Priya Patel: will start a short nomination thread and tag suggested candidates. ETA Monday.

Jordan Lee: office-hours signup blurb (will post to workspace): "Office hours for Dedicated follow-up: Thu 10:00-10:30 PT. Sign-up: https://cal.link/redwood-dedicated-office-hours"

Ben Wu: happy to be backup for office hours if Miguel is on customer calls.

Jordan Lee: final: if you react :thumbsup: to your owner line i'll assume confirmed. otherwise reply here. i'll keep this thread updated and link to a public follow-up doc once the items are posted.

Samir (ops-bot): reminder set for owners in 72 hours.
